strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed. The group re-formed in most resamplings of the data (stability 0.61).

Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. Split into buying goods from community, farm or museum shops and getting help with shopping tasks, with borrowing tools and equipment as a third part.

section.p: Identifier in this run: svc-072. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
